prompts.traps: Create an original game sprite sheet for an isometric mobile village strategy game, with the chunky hand-painted pre-rendered 3D look of early Clash of Clans. Actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow or glow, no environment or text. Three equal square cells in one horizontal row, fully separated, identical camera looking down at 30 degrees, front face towards lower-left, warm upper-left sunlight. Cell 1: a small upright honey-brown wooden coffin with chamfered shoulder corners, two horizontal wooden bars nailed across its front, a small ivory skull badge between the bars, a little dark brown earth mound around its bottom. Cell 2: exactly the same coffin, except its ivory badge is a simple bat-like pair of wings instead of a skull. Cell 3: same coffin now open and empty, lid lying beside it, dark interior, small dirt mound; no skeleton, no bones or gore. All three fully framed with 15 percent transparent margin. Crisp, thick bevels, readable toy-like shapes. No metal spikes, gold studs, flowers, grass, labels, or added characters.
prompts.ground-walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Original mobile strategy game animation sprite strip on a REAL TRANSPARENT PNG background (alpha zero outside objects). No backdrop, checkerboard pattern, shadow, glow, haze or text. Chunky toy-like 3D ivory skeleton warrior, big round skull with black eye sockets and broad teeth, visible ribs and bare bone limbs, one short broad steel sword with brown grip in the right hand. No armor, clothes, shield, goggles or helmet. Orthographic isometric camera looking down 30 degrees, facing lower-left, warm upper-left lighting only on object surfaces. Exactly 4 complete characters in ONE horizontal row of 4 equally sized SQUARE cells, each pose fills at most the central 65 percent of its cell. Generous transparent margin on all four sides of every pose. Identical character design, scale, camera and feet baseline. No object crosses its cell boundary. Four distinct walking poses, left-foot-forward, passing step, right-foot-forward, alternate passing step. Sword carried down in the right hand.Every empty pixel must have real alpha transparency; absolutely no floor, gradient or checkerboard.
